blocks.text: Jimin of BTS generated 10 million views on TikTok in less than a day on Monday with his first video on the platform under his personal profile. The video contains the full choreography for “Be Mine,” a B-side track from his second solo EP “Muse,” and shows Jimin freely roaming the seashore. READ: WATCH: BTS’ Jimin kisses little girl battling cancer at Texas concert As of Wednesday, the video had clocked more than 15 million hits and 6 million likes.
